Class FieldMappingEngine

public inherited sharing class FieldMappingEngine

Handles dynamic field mapping between JSON source data and Salesforce SObject target records. Supports multiple mapping modes including direct field mapping, fixed values, and formula-based transformations. Provides type conversion, external ID lookups, required field validation, and custom validation formulas through integration with ReplicationSettings metadata and FormulaEval engine.

Group:
    Utilities

Since:
    05/04/2025

Version:
    1.4


Change Log

  • 05/04/2025 - v1.0 - Initial version.
  • 06/22/2025 - v1.1 - Method mapRecord() can now receive a JSONRecord directly.
  • 07/12/2025 - v1.2 - Added MapRecordResult class to encapsulate the mapping result. Validate required fields and validation formula (if defined) for child records.
  • 11/07/2025 - v1.3 - Added methods to get additional data from replication settings as raw string or parsed map.
  • 01/11/2026 - v1.4 - Added static getFormulaValue() method to evaluate formulas based on field mapping configuration.

  JSONUtils.JSONRecord jsonDoc,

Parameters:
    jsonDoc – JSONUtils.JSONRecord: JSON document containing the source data
    fieldMapping – FieldMap: Field mapping configuration specifying source, target, and transformation rules

Returns:
    FieldValue: Object containing the mapped value and its defined status

private static Object getFormulaValue(
  SObject record,
  FormulaEval.FormulaInstance fi,
  FormulaEval.FormulaReturnType returnType
)

Evaluates a pre-compiled formula instance against an SObject record. Handles type conversion for date formulas by converting the Datetime result to a GMT date.

    record – SObject: The SObject record to evaluate the formula against
    fi – FormulaEval.FormulaInstance: The pre-compiled formula instance to evaluate
    returnType – FormulaEval.FormulaReturnType: The expected return type of the formula

Returns:
    Object: The result of the formula evaluation, with date conversion applied if needed

    01/11/2026

@TestVisible
private Object getFormulaValue(
  SObject record,
  String fieldFormula,
  FormulaEval.FormulaReturnType returnType
)

Evaluates a formula for a given SObject record using the FormulaEval engine. Caches formula instances to optimize repeated evaluations of the same formula. Handles type conversion for date formulas.

Parameters:
    record – SObject: The SObject record to evaluate the formula against
    fieldFormula – String: The formula expression to evaluate
    returnType – FormulaEval.FormulaReturnType: The expected return type of the formula

Returns:

public FieldMappingEngine.MapRecordResult mapRecord(JSONUtils.JSONRecord jsonDoc)

Maps a JSON record to a target SObject record based on the field mapping settings. Processes field mappings, fixed values, and formulas, then validates required fields and custom validation formulas.

Returns:
    MapRecordResult: Mapping result with validation status and SObject record populated with the mapped values if successful
